required: target checkout matching its source snapshot
optional: accepted tool-lead producers (source/native SAST, secrets, IaC, mobile)

applicability: every full review with a readable source checkout; zero instances (SKIPPED_NA) otherwise

shard_groups.description: Hunter shard groups: component shards are packed into this many groups by size, P1/P2-lead-heavy components first.
shard_groups.scale: Pool size = shard_groups x modes_per_group; each instance is one claude -p call capped at budget_max_usd_per_call[standard] (2.0 USD today).

modes_per_group.description: 1: groups alternate general / known-list hunters; 2: every group gets both hunters (doubles instances and cost).

max_hypotheses_per_instance.description: Most hypotheses one hunter instance may propose; excess items are recorded as dropped gaps.

max_line_span.description: Widest line range one hypothesis may name; wider ranges are dropped as gaps.

target_pin_bytes_max.description: Target bytes pinned per instance (also capped at half the cell's persona input byte budget); files beyond it stay reachable through evidence_search / evidence_read.
target_pin_bytes_max.scale: Grows with component size; large repositories need more shard_groups rather than a larger window.

file_bytes_max.description: Largest single target file pinned for code reading; larger or binary files are listed as unpinned.

lead_menu_max.description: Most P1/P2 tool leads listed in one hunter brief (the total is always stated).

max_parallel.description: Hunter instances dispatched concurrently (the persona_llm resource pool bounds it too).

rendezvous_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock wait for every hunter instance of the pool.
